title: VideoTranscriptRAGOutput
description: Structured output payload returned by the 6-agent Video QA engine.

answer.description: Grounded Markdown response with inline timestamp citations in [MM:SS] format.

confidence.description: Evidence verification confidence score from 0.0 to 1.0.

classified_intent.description: Classified intent of the user query.

normalized_query.description: Normalized form of the original user query.

citations.description: List of evidence chunks cited and verified in the response.

audit_trail.description: Execution traces and status logs recorded by each of the 6 agents.
